title: Novena to the Immaculate Conception
description: A nine-day prayer to the Immaculate Conception, celebrating Mary's unique privilege of being conceived without original sin and seeking her powerful intercession for purity of heart, protection from evil, and the grace to live as a beloved child of God. This devotion honors the first moment of Mary's existence when God preserved her from all stain of sin.
intention: For purity of heart, mind, and body; protection from temptation and evil; deeper conversion to Christ; and the grace to live as a beloved child of God
instructions: Pray this novena for 9 consecutive days, especially in preparation for the Solemnity of the Immaculate Conception on December 8. This novena is particularly powerful for those seeking purity in a world that often promotes impurity, for those struggling with habits of sin, and for those who wish to consecrate themselves more fully to Mary. The Immaculate Conception is the patroness of the United States, and this novena is especially meaningful for American Catholics.
background_info: The dogma of the Immaculate Conception, solemnly defined by Pope Pius IX in 1854, teaches that the Blessed Virgin Mary, from the first instant of her conception, was preserved free from all stain of original sin by a singular grace and privilege of Almighty God, in view of the merits of Jesus Christ. Mary appeared to St. Bernadette at Lourdes in 1858 and confirmed this doctrine by identifying herself as 'The Immaculate Conception.' The United States was placed under the patronage of the Immaculate Conception in 1846, and the Basilica of the National Shrine of the Immaculate Conception in Washington, D.C. is the largest Catholic church in North America.

days.title: Day 1: Singular Grace and Privilege
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Conception, from the very first moment of your existence, God preserved you from all stain of original sin. This singular grace and privilege, given in view of the merits of your Son Jesus Christ, made you a worthy vessel to become the Mother of God. I marvel at this extraordinary gift and at the love of God who prepared you so perfectly for your unique role in salvation history. You were conceived without sin not for your own sake but to become the spotless ark of the New Covenant, the pure vessel who would carry the Word made flesh. God's plan for your life began before you were even born, showing that He has plans for each of us that begin at the moment of our conception. Help me to see my own life as part of God's plan from before my birth. Though I was conceived with original sin, I was cleansed in the waters of Baptism and called to a unique purpose. Help me to discover and fulfill the mission God has for me. Like you, may I prepare myself daily to be a vessel of God's grace in the world. O Immaculate Conception, obtain for me the grace to understand my calling and to live it with the faithfulness you showed. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: The Immaculate Conception reminds us that God's plan for each person begins before birth. Mary's preservation from sin was a unique gift preparing her for her role as Mother of God, showing how God prepares each of us for our unique mission.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Mary, help me to understand my God-given purpose and to prepare myself daily to be a vessel of His grace in the world.
days.scripture: "Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart." - Jeremiah 1:5

days.title: Day 2: Full of Grace
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Conception, the Archangel Gabriel greeted you with the words 'Hail, full of grace,' revealing that you were already completely filled with God's grace from the moment of your conception. To be 'full of grace' means that there was no room in your soul for sin or for anything that separates from God. Every moment of your existence was lived in perfect communion with Him. I contrast your fullness with my own emptiness - empty because of the spaces in my heart filled with selfishness, pride, and sin rather than with God's grace. I am often depleted, lacking the charity, patience, and love I need for daily life. O Mother, help me to open myself more fully to God's grace. Where sin has created voids in my soul, let His grace flood in. Where selfishness has left me empty, let charity fill me. Where pride has kept me from receiving, let humility make me receptive. You were full of grace because you were completely open to God's will - 'let it be done to me according to your word.' Teach me your openness and receptivity. Help me to say 'yes' to God in all things, that I too may be filled with His grace. O Mary, full of grace, obtain for me a share in your fullness. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: Gabriel's greeting 'full of grace' (Kecharitomene) indicates Mary's unique state of being completely filled with divine favor. Her openness to God's will allowed His grace to fully permeate her being, making her the perfect vessel for Christ.
days.intention_prayer: Mary, full of grace, help me to open my heart to receive God's grace fully, removing all that keeps me from being filled with His love.
days.scripture: "The angel went to her and said, 'Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.'" - Luke 1:28

days.title: Day 3: Purity of Heart
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Conception, you were preserved from all stain of sin - not only original sin but every personal sin. Your heart was completely pure, free from any darkness or selfishness. You loved God with your whole heart, soul, mind, and strength, and you loved your neighbor as yourself. I long for this purity of heart, but mine is often divided. I am pulled in many directions by competing desires and attachments. My thoughts are not always pure, my motives are sometimes mixed, and my love is often self-interested. The world around me promotes impurity through images, entertainment, and messages that degrade human dignity and lead me away from God. Help me, O Immaculate Mother, to grow in purity of heart. Cleanse my thoughts of all that is unworthy of a child of God. Purify my intentions so that I do good for the right reasons, not for praise or reward. Help me to love God above all things and my neighbor as myself, without selfish calculation. Where I have allowed impurity to enter my mind or heart through media, entertainment, or my own thoughts, wash me clean in the blood of your Son and help me to guard my senses more carefully. Give me the courage to avoid occasions of impurity and to fill my mind with what is true, good, and beautiful. O Immaculate Heart, obtain for me purity of heart. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: Mary's Immaculate Conception preserved her in perfect purity of heart, free from all selfishness and sin. Purity of heart means having single-minded devotion to God, loving Him above all things and seeing Him in every person.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Mary, purify my heart of all selfish desires and attachments. Give me the grace to love God with an undivided heart.
days.scripture: "Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God." - Matthew 5:8

days.title: Day 4: Protection from Evil
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Conception, from the beginning, God said there would be enmity between you and the serpent, between your offspring and his. You were created sinless, and the evil one had no claim on you whatsoever. You stand as the great enemy of the devil, the woman whose offspring would crush the serpent's head. In my own life, I face spiritual warfare - the attacks of the evil one who seeks to lead me away from God. I experience temptations to sin, discouragement in prayer, and temptations to despair. The world, the flesh, and the devil combine to draw me from the path of holiness. I need your protection, O Immaculate Mother. You who are the terror of demons, protect me from all spiritual danger. When I am tempted, remind me of your Son's promises and strengthen me to resist. When I am discouraged, help me to trust in God's love. When I feel overcome by darkness, be my light. Protect my mind from evil thoughts, my heart from hatred and resentment, my body from impurity, my soul from despair. Guard my home and my family from all the attacks of the evil one. Help me to recognize temptation for what it is and to flee from occasions of sin. Stand between me and the enemy of my soul, and obtain for me all the graces I need to resist and overcome. O Immaculate Conception, my protectress, defend me from all evil. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: God declared enmity between the woman and the serpent (Genesis 3:15), fulfilled in Mary, whose sinlessness made her immune to the devil's power. As the woman who crushes the serpent's head, she protects her children from spiritual danger.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Mary, terror of demons, protect me from all the attacks of the evil one. Stand between me and every spiritual danger.
days.scripture: "And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel." - Genesis 3:15

days.title: Day 5: Consecration to Jesus through Mary
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Conception, you gave your flesh to the Word made flesh. He entered the world through you, and in doing so, He sanctified the path of Marian consecration - coming to Jesus through Mary. All grace comes to us through you, for you are the channel through which Jesus came into the world. I wish to consecrate myself anew to Jesus through your Immaculate Heart. I offer myself to you, my body, my soul, my intellect, my will, my memory, my imagination, my strength, my possessions, my work, and my entire life. All that I have and all that I am belongs to you. Do with me according to your good pleasure. Use me for the greater glory of God and for the salvation of souls. I ask not to be rich, famous, or comfortable - only to be holy, to know and do God's will, and to love Him above all things. Since you were completely consecrated to God from the first moment of your existence, teach me what true consecration means. Help me to live no longer for myself but for Him who died and rose for me. Keep me always in your Immaculate Heart as a consecrated child, and present me to your Son as His devoted follower. O Immaculate Conception, I am yours, and all I have is yours. Lead me to Jesus. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: Total consecration to Jesus through Mary, taught by St. Louis de Montfort, recognizes that as Jesus came to us through Mary, we best come to Him through her. This consecration offers everything to Mary for her to present to Jesus.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Mary, I consecrate myself entirely to you. Accept me as your child and use me for the glory of God and the salvation of souls.
days.scripture: "And Mary said: 'My soul glorifies the Lord and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior.'" - Luke 1:46-47

days.title: Day 6: The Mother of God
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Conception, your preservation from sin was necessary because you were destined to become the Mother of God. The Word made flesh took His human nature from you - His body was formed from your body, His blood from your blood. You are truly the Mother of God, not just the mother of His human nature. The Council of Ephesus in 431 proclaimed you as Theotokos, God-bearer, confirming that you are the Mother of the one divine Person of Jesus Christ, who is both fully God and fully man. What an awesome dignity and responsibility was yours! You carried God in your womb, held Him in your arms, and nursed Him at your breast. Yet this role was not only a privilege but also a call to service. You offered your Son to the Father in the temple, sought Him when He was lost, followed Him during His ministry, and stood at the foot of His cross. Your motherhood continues in the Church as you care for all who are united to your Son in Baptism. Help me to understand and embrace my own vocation with the same faithfulness you showed. Whether I am called to be a parent, a religious, a single person, or a member of any other state in life, help me to offer myself completely to God and to serve Him in whatever way He asks. O Mother of God, show me how to fulfill my calling. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: Mary's title 'Mother of God' (Theotokos) was defined at the Council of Ephesus (431), affirming that she is mother of the one Person of Christ, who is both divine and human. Her preservation from sin prepared her for this unique dignity.
days.intention_prayer: Mother of God, teach me to embrace my own vocation with the same faithfulness you showed in yours. Help me to offer myself completely to God.
days.scripture: "But when the set time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law." - Galatians 4:4

days.title: Day 7: Patroness of the United States
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Conception, in 1846, the bishops of the United States proclaimed you as the patroness of our country under this title. Eight years later, Pope Pius IX solemnly defined the dogma of the Immaculate Conception, confirming what our bishops had already discerned - that you are the special protector of this nation. I entrust my country to your Immaculate Heart. Our nation faces many challenges: division among our people, attacks on religious freedom, the culture of death that rejects the sanctity of human life, and many other evils. As our patroness, watch over the United States and intercede for us. Convert the hearts of those who promote policies contrary to God's law. Protect and strengthen those who work for justice, life, and religious liberty. Guide our leaders to make decisions that reflect God's truth and promote the common good. Help all citizens to recognize that true freedom is found not in doing whatever we want but in doing what is right. I also ask you to watch over my family and me. Protect us from all dangers, provide for our needs, and guide us in your ways. May our home honor you as our mother and patroness, and may we live as faithful citizens both of our country and of heaven. O Immaculate Conception, patroness of the United States, pray for us. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: The United States was placed under Mary's patronage as the Immaculate Conception in 1846, eight years before the dogma was defined. The Basilica of the National Shrine of the Immaculate Conception in Washington, D.C. testifies to this national devotion.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Conception, patroness of the United States, watch over our nation. Convert hearts, protect religious freedom, and guide us to be faithful citizens of both country and heaven.
days.scripture: "Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people." - Proverbs 14:34

days.title: Day 8: The Model of Holiness
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Conception, from the first moment of your existence, you were holy - completely united to God, filled with His grace, and free from all sin. You are the model of what every human person is called to be. Your holiness was not passive but active - you grew in grace throughout your life, deepening your love for God and your understanding of His plan. You pondered God's word in your heart, served others in love, and offered your Son to the Father with complete trust. I look at your holiness and then examine my own life: my compromises with sin, my lukewarm love, my half-hearted service. Yet you do not condemn me but invite me to follow you on the path of holiness. Teach me, O Immaculate Mother, what it means to be holy as you are holy. Help me to spend time with God in daily prayer, pondering His word as you did. Help me to serve others with the same love you showed at the wedding at Cana and throughout your Son's ministry. Help me to offer my sufferings with trust as you stood at the foot of the cross. Let your holiness inspire me but not discourage me, for I know that God's grace can transform even the greatest sinner. You were preserved from sin; I was cleansed from it in Baptism and can be cleansed again in Confession. Help me to cooperate with the graces God offers me for my sanctification. O Immaculate Mother, model of holiness, make me like you. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
days.reflection: Mary's sinlessness and complete union with God make her the perfect model of holiness. She shows us what every human person is called to be - filled with grace, pondering God's word, serving others, and offering ourselves completely to God.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Mary, model of holiness, teach me to live as you lived - in constant union with God, pondering His word, serving others, and offering myself completely to Him.
days.scripture: "But we all, with unveiled face, beholding as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into the same image from glory to glory." - 2 Corinthians 3:18

days.title: Day 9: The Dawn of Salvation
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Conception, your conception was the dawn of salvation, the first light of the new creation that would be fully revealed in your Son. In preserving you from original sin, God began the defeat of the ancient serpent and the restoration of humanity. You are the new Eve, whose 'yes' undid the disobedience of the first Eve. You are the new Ark of the Covenant, pure and undefiled. You are the woman clothed with the sun, whose offspring would conquer the dragon. As I conclude this novena, I thank God for the gift of your Immaculate Conception and for all the graces I have received through this devotion. Increase my love for you and for your Son. Help me to live in the light of your sinlessness, fighting against sin in my life and growing in holiness. May the dawn of salvation that began with your conception continue to spread its light through me into the darkness of the world. Help me to bring Christ to others as you brought Him to Elizabeth and to the world. May my life prepare the way for His coming in glory. I renew my consecration to you now, promising to honor you as my Immaculate Mother, to pray the rosary with devotion, to frequent the sacraments, and to live as a child of the light. O Immaculate Conception, dawn of salvation, bring me to the fullness of light in heaven. Amen.
days.closing_prayer:
O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.

A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
days.reflection: Mary's Immaculate Conception marks the beginning of the new creation, the dawn of salvation that would culminate in Christ. As the new Eve, her obedience began the reversal of humanity's fall, bringing light into the darkness of sin.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Mary, dawn of salvation, increase my love for you and your Son. Help me to live in your light and to bring Christ's light to the world until I see Him face to face in heaven.
days.scripture: "A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head." - Revelation 12:1

source: Traditional Catholic Novena to the Immaculate Conception
notes: This novena is traditionally prayed from November 29 to December 7 in preparation for the Solemnity of the Immaculate Conception on December 8, a holy day of obligation in the United States. The Immaculate Conception is the patroness of the United States, and devotion to her under this title has a special place in American Catholic life. Those who pray this novena are encouraged to attend Mass on December 8 and to receive the sacraments in honor of Our Lady's Immaculate Conception.
